name: Sunshine Coast Hinterland Holiday Builder 🌿
heroTagline: Rainforest retreats, mountain lookouts, and farm-fresh charm — Queensland's green escape.

region.description: Lush rainforest, volcanic peaks, waterfall walks, and charming mountain villages — the hinterland offers a slower, greener family holiday with cabins, farm stays, and stunning lookouts.

areas.name: Maleny
areas.description: The heart of the hinterland — dairy farms, botanic gardens, Mary Cairncross Reserve, boutique cafes, and stunning Glass House Mountain views.

areas.name: Montville
areas.description: Charming mountain village — Gallery Walk artisan shops, rainforest retreats, waterfall walks at Kondalilla, and escarpment dining with panoramic views.

areas.name: Mapleton
areas.description: Quiet hinterland town surrounded by rainforest — Mapleton Falls, gentle walks, and a relaxed village atmosphere perfect for unwinding.

areas.name: Glass House Mountains
areas.description: Dramatic volcanic peaks and scenic lookouts — family-friendly walks, Australia Zoo nearby, and iconic Queensland landscapes.

driving.parkingNote: Most hinterland attractions offer free parking. Village parking in Montville and Maleny can be tight on weekends — arrive before 10am.

airportTransfer.familyShuttle: Approx. $90-$130 family return from Sunshine Coast Airport to Maleny.
airportTransfer.rideShare: Approx. $55-$80 from Sunshine Coast Airport to Maleny.

meta.priceAccuracyNote: All prices and costs are estimates generated on 2026-07-12. Availability and final pricing must be confirmed with each provider. The Sunshine Coast Hinterland Holiday Builder does not sell tickets, take bookings, or hold money.
meta.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by any listed accommodation, attraction, restaurant, or retail business. Logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
